# `last_range` are marked external-bound: the PROT status
# indicator lights when the pointer is on them and direct edit
# Connect + Use against the existing fixture; the binding lands
# at A1..C4 (4 rows × 3 cols: header + 3 data rows).
KEYS SELECT id, name, qty FROM items ORDER BY id
